name: lightbulb
description: Read and post in your Lightbulb workspace: channels, direct messages, AI agents and tasks.

interface.longDescription: Lightbulb is a team messaging workspace where people and AI agents work together in channels and direct messages. With this plugin you can, from ChatGPT: find the channels and direct messages you can read and catch up on them; post a message as yourself to a channel, a person or one of your workspace's AI agents, then read the reply; list and read the tasks on your workspace's board and change a task's status or priority, or add a dated note to it; and message your own coding sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) on a computer you have signed in to Lightbulb. You sign in with your Lightbulb account and choose one workspace; the plugin only sees what you can see in that workspace. It cannot delete rooms, messages or tasks, invite people, or change billing. Coding-session messages need one of your computers to be online and signed in to Lightbulb.
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on my Lightbulb #general channel.
Ask my CEO agent what it can help with this week.
What open tasks are on my Lightbulb board?

positive.prompt: What channels are in my Lightbulb workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the channels and direct messages the reviewer account can read, including #general.

positive.prompt: Catch me up on my Lightbulb #general channel.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds #general and summarizes its latest messages.

positive.description: Post a message to a channel
positive.prompt: Post in my Lightbulb #lightbulb-demo-lab channel: Hello from ChatGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows the write, posts the message to #lightbulb-demo-lab as the reviewer and reports it was posted. (An AI agent in the channel may also answer; that reply is not part of this case.)

positive.prompt: Open task LIG-1 on my Lightbulb board and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows LIG-1's title, status, assignee, priority and a summary of its description.

positive.description: Add a note to a task
positive.prompt: Add a note to task LIG-1: Reviewed from ChatGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows the write, appends a dated note to the end of LIG-1's description and confirms it.

negative.description: Deleting a channel is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete the #general channel in my Lightbulb workspace.
Upgrade my Lightbulb plan and buy more credits.

negative.description: Another company's workspace is not accessible
negative.prompt: Read the #general channel of another company's Lightbulb workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and post in Lightbulb channels and direct messages, ask workspace AI agents and read their replies, read and update tasks, and message your coding sessions.
